notes.title: The demo beta is over, thanks for your feedback!
notes.content: Damn, we really blew the only two things we wanted to say in the headline. Anyway cheers!

notes.title: Demo update live
notes.content:
In case you haven't noticed, the Playtest has re-opened its slumbering maw and spewn forth a demo! We just patched it today, but honestly, if you already finished it there's nothing worth going back for. This is mainly for folks who didn't realise they had access to it yet. Hi, those folks!

[h3]Patch notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dall's showcase goal now requires less special knowledge.
[*] Disabled some dev options.
[*] Clarified phrasing of some objectives.
[*] Added Beastie Boysesque emphasis to flyer.
[/list]

Feedback before May 13th is extra appreciated!

notes.title: Beta ends in 24 hours, last chance to fill in your feedback forms!
notes.content:
In 24 hours we'll shut down the current beta. Once it's over, you won't be able to play, or access the feedback form. We'd love for you to fill that out with your impressions, so perhaps you could do it now! It's accessible from the in-game menu any time you hit Escape. Every question on the form is optional, so you can just fill out the bits you have thoughts on / time for.

Thanks to all 800 of you who've already done so!
